html:
In Australia, we enjoy a sunny climate however this does mean we need to be mindful of ensuring protection from the damage caused by harmful UV rays. UV rays can cause skin cancer, premature aging & eye damage – Australia has one of the highest rates of skin cancer in the world.

UV window coatings are a great option for providing protection in both your car and your home. Below, we list the UV coating for windows that we offer. Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications and up to 15 years on commercial applications. Here are the UV window coatings in our range

UV Window Coatings In Our Range

All our UV coating for windows are exclusive to us and are government certified by ARPANSA (Australian Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety Agency) to ensure the highest quality. ARPANSA is the Australian Government’s primary authority on radiation protection and nuclear safety helping to protect Australian’s from the harmful effects of UV.

UV rays can also cause your floorings and furnishing to fade prematurely. The good news is that UV window coatings also help to reduce fading caused by UV rays.

Here are the residential UV window coatings in our range:

  • Solar window films – reduces the amount of heat & glare that enters your home
  • Privacy films – adds privacy during the day without reducing natural light entering your home
  • Safety films – holds shattered glass together helping to prevent injury
  • Security films – hinders entry into your home
